notes:
### Added

- **Sessions: minutes on debt or "to pay at the end", for one PC or many.** "Shto kohë" now has three ways to pay, the same for one PC and for a selection of several: now (cash, card, split), "Pagesë në fund" — nothing is taken now, the minutes go on each PC's bill and come up at the desk when the session ends — and "Borxh" on a registered customer's name. Until now a batch of PCs took cash or card only, and for a single PC the customer picked in the window was never sent, so "pay later" was refused. Minutes added "to pay at the end" are owed in full once the time runs out; when the session is stopped earlier only the time used beyond the paid part is owed; taking minutes off removes the unpaid ones first. The PC's widget shows what is owed for them.
- **Sessions: the customer by name.** "Klienti" on a running session (and for several selected PCs at once) puts the registered customer — or a typed name — on the PC, and changes or clears it until the bill is paid. The tile and the selection bar show the name and what is unpaid right now. A click on the name opens the customer's bill: every PC they have open, what was bought on each, what is unpaid now, the debt from before, the total — and "Paguaj". Products put on the PC take the customer's name.
- **One receipt for several PCs, at any time.** "Paguaj" for one PC, for the selected ones or for all: one window, one total, one payment (cash, card, split, or debt on one name), one receipt with a line per PC and the products of each. The customer can pay before the session ends: a paid PC pays its added minutes and its products and runs on; a "pay at the end" PC pays its reserved amount and runs on as a paid session; open time is stopped and billed by default, and with the switch off it pays the time so far and runs on (the rest is owed at the end, and such a session can no longer be cancelled). "Paguaj të gjitha" of the waiting list makes one receipt too (it made one per bill) and includes paid PCs that ended with products.
- **Nothing ends unpaid without being seen.** The waiting list ("Për arkëtim") is also on the POS page. When a PC ends with something unpaid — time or products — the Admin beeps and says so on whatever page is open, with the amount. Closing the till names the PC bills that are still unpaid, with a button to them. A cancelled session keeps the products that were on its bill on the waiting list instead of dropping them, and a paid session that ends with unpaid added minutes waits like any other bill.
- **Prices: "Falas deri në (minuta)".** A price rule can give the first minutes free: a session no longer than that costs nothing; past it the whole time is charged from the first minute. 0 (the default) changes nothing. It applies to measured time — open time, or "pay at the end" stopped early — never to minutes that were bought.
- **Internet access on a quick bar.** A slim bar at the bottom of the POS and of the Stations page with up to four packages, name and price only. On the POS a click puts the package in the cart; on Stations it opens a small sale. The code is shown only after the payment, never before. Which packages are there is chosen with "Në shirit" in the package's codes window; with none chosen the first packages show by themselves.
- **Offers: products and PC minutes at one price.** Admin › Products has an "Ofertat" card. "Ofertë e re" takes the products, the minutes (none for a products-only offer) and the price; the name is made from them ("Coca-Cola + 60 min") until one is typed. "Bëje ofertë" on a product's row opens the same form with that product already in it, so only the price is left to type. Each offer has a switch that takes it off the till and puts it back. On the POS the offers are tiles marked "Ofertë" — first under "Të gjitha", alone under the "Ofertat" chip: a click asks which PC gets the minutes (or a name, when the customer has no PC yet) and puts one line at the offer's price in the cart, beside any other product. On Stations a selected PC has the action "Ofertë": pick the offer, take the money. When the sale is paid a free PC starts with the minutes and a running one gets them added (a paid or pay-at-the-end session; a PC on open time takes none); without a PC the minutes are sold to a name with a PIN, like PC time at the till. The receipt has one row for the offer, with what it holds under it. Each product leaves the stock, and the sale keeps one line per product and one for the time — together they cost the offer's price, shared by what each costs outside the offer — so stock, profit, tax and time reports count an offer as any other sale. An offer is paid at the till: it is not parked, not put on a PC's bill, not a staff purchase and not sold offline; a product that ran out stops the whole offer.
- API: `POST /sessions/pay/quote`, `POST /sessions/pay`, `PATCH /sessions/:id/customer`, `GET /sessions/open-bills`, `GET /sessions/by-sale/:saleId/receipt`, `PUT /internet-access/bar`, `GET/POST /offers`, `PUT/PATCH/DELETE /offers/:id`, an item `{ offerId, stationId?, holderName? }` and `offerStarts` on `POST /sales`; `later` and `customerId` on `POST /sessions/:id/extend` and `POST /sessions/bulk-minutes`; `dueCents`, `advanceCents`, `unpaidSeconds` on a session, `customerId` and `dueCents` on a station's session, `freeMinutes` on a price rule, `inBar` on a package; setting `pos.internet_bar`. See `docs/network-protocol.md`.
- Migrations `0060_session_open_amounts.sql` (`gaming_sessions.unpaid_cents`, `unpaid_seconds`, `paid_cents`; `pricing_rules.free_minutes`), `0061_bill_without_receipt.sql` and `0062_offers.sql` (`offers`, `offer_items`; `sale_items.offer_id`, `offer_name`, `offer_group`).

### Changed

- A bill that owes nothing — a session inside its free minutes, or one that was paid in full while it ran, with no product on it — is closed without a receipt of 0.00 and does not wait at the desk.
- Admin › Stations: six actions fit in the bar before "Më shumë", so "Shto kohë (n)" and "Paguaj (n)" for several selected PCs are in view.
